title: A Comparison Theorem for $p$-adic GKZ Hypergeometric $\mathcal D$-Modules and Complexes
summary: We compare the $p$-adic GKZ hypergeometric complex with the hypergeometric arithmetic $\mathcal D$-module defined via six functors. Under the $p$-adic semi-nonresonance condition, the natural comparison morphism is a quasi-isomorphism. We prove concentration of the $p$-adic GKZ hypergeometric complex in degree $n$, establish overholonomicity under another non-Liouville hypothesis.
